# Afthyir

Afthyir is the online name of Afthy Irshath, a full-stack developer and cybersecurity student.

- Website: https://www.afthyir.co.uk/
- GitHub: https://github.com/afthyir
- Profile repository: https://github.com/afthyir/afthyir

## Profile

Afthyir builds web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js, and uses Python for scripting and backend work. The stated stack also includes Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Vercel and Railway.

Current learning interests include networking, Linux and cybersecurity fundamentals.
